name: Lume
description: Lume is a static site generator for Deno that builds sites from Markdown and a choice of template engines.
notes: Runs on Deno, not Node.js. Lume is imported from CDN URL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/lumeland/lume@3.3.2/ (pinned in src/deno.json, lockfile src/deno.lock); all remote and npm modules are cached into DENO_DIR at image build, so the timed `deno task build` (run with --cached-only --frozen) is offline. Post URLs keep the date prefix of the file name (/posts/YYYY-MM-DD-N/). Vento is Lume's default template engine.
